messages:
renee-cs: GlyphAI onboarding — heads up, partner demo Fri 16:00 PT. They need west-hemisphere egress route + temp QPS bump to handle ~50 req/s demo traffic. Also asked for region pin to US-WEST only. Account at 62% of trial credits; renewal chatter may hinge on this run. Can we get an allowlist + 24h rate bump?
jason-netops: @renee-cs I can do allowlist + route. Need their CIDR and org-id. QPS bump — what's SLA window and durations?
renee-cs: Sending details now. Demo window 2024-11-01T23:00Z - 2024-11-02T03:00Z. Temp bump 50→200 QPS, auto-revoke after 6h. CIDR 34.82.11.0/24. Org glyphai-prod-7.
liam-eng: For region pin we can set policy to prefer us-west and fallback to global if capacity low. Confirm if strict pin required.
emily-pm: Renewal at EOM — success here helps conversion. Please tag CS post-demo for enablement notes.
jason-netops: Got CIDR/org. I'll push allowlist and create RBAC entry. Config snippet:
```json
{ "org": "glyphai-prod-7", "allowlist": ["34.82.11.0/24"], "regions": ["us-west*"], "qps_temp": 200, "revoke_after": "6h" }
```
ops-bot: deploy-task created #DT-4321 — allowlist applied to edge-west, traffic routing update queued.
jason-netops: Done — allowlist applied to edge-west. QPS bump scheduled 2024-11-01T23:00Z. Auto-revoke job created.
renee-cs: Awesome, thanks. I'll prep enablement playbook and send post-demo feedback form. @emily-pm flag for renewal outreach.
emily-pm: noted. I'll set a renewal call next week if demo goes well.
liam-eng: FYI we'll monitor latencies; if tail spikes, fallback to lower-QPS variant. Ping if any client error >1%.
renee-cs: Will capture feedback and any SDK issues. Closing loop once demo complete. :thumbsup:
